CEFoodAgedCheesePart.description: A triangle of richly flavored aged cheese.

CEFoodAgedCheeseSlice.name: aged cheese slice
CEFoodAgedCheeseSlice.description: A thin slice of richly flavored aged cheese.

CEFoodBreadBun.name: bread bun
CEFoodBreadBun.description: it's like regular bread, only smaller and funnier.

CEFoodBreadBunBottom.name: bottom bread bun
CEFoodBreadBunBottom.description: It's like regular bread, only smaller and funnier. And cut in half.

CEFoodBreadBunTop.name: top bread bun
CEFoodBreadBunTop.description: It's like regular bread, only smaller and funnier. And cut in half.

CEFoodMeatLambCutlet.name: lamb cutlet
CEFoodMeatLambCutlet.description: The result of mixing sliced lamb and egg - a raw round cutlet.

CEFoodMeatFrogLeg.name: frog leg
CEFoodMeatFrogLeg.description: They say they eat it somewhere.

CEFoodMeatHuman.name: raw human meat
CEFoodMeatHuman.description: This meat has a suspicious look to it.

CEFoodMeatDino.name: raw dino meat
CEFoodMeatDino.description: Now who's going to eat who?

CEFoodMeatHydra.name: raw hydra meat
CEFoodMeatHydra.description: Not as much meat as I would have liked.

CEFoodMeatRabbit.name: raw rabbit meat
CEFoodMeatRabbit.description: The meat seems tough and the odour is unpleasant.

CEFoodMeatRabbitCooked.name: cooked rabbit meat
CEFoodMeatRabbitCooked.description: The frying went to good use, now the meat seems juicy and tender.

CEFoodMeatBoarCooked.name: cooked boar meat

CEFoodMeatPigSlice.description: Pork meat ball with veins of lard.

CEFoodMeatMonsterLeg.name: raw monster leg meat
CEFoodMeatMonsterLeg.description: The suspicious colour of the meat makes you question its edibility, but if you're really hungry...

CEFoodMeatMonsterSlice.name: monster meat piece
CEFoodMeatMonsterSlice.description: Monster meat balls with their trademark suspicious colour.

CEFoodMeatFlemLeg.name: raw flem leg
CEFoodMeatFlemLeg.description: Probably not the best part to eat. but you never know until you try.

CEFoodPumpkinSlice.name: pumpkin slice
CEFoodPumpkinSlice.description: Sliced pumpkin, ready to be cooked or eaten raw.

CEFoodCucumberSlice.name: cucumber slice
CEFoodCucumberSlice.description: An evenly cut cucumber, still as green and watery.

CEFoodTomatoesSlice.name: tomato slice
CEFoodTomatoesSlice.description: Thin red tomato slice. It's no longer as nice to throw at people as whole tomatoes.

CEFoodAppleSlice.name: apple slice
CEFoodAppleSlice.description: Small slices to eat at one time.

CEFoodGarlicClove.name: garlic clove
CEFoodGarlicClove.description: A single clove of garlic, potent and aromatic.

CEFoodCarrotSlice.name: carrot slice
CEFoodCarrotSlice.description: A neatly sliced piece of carrot.

CEFoodOnionSlice.name: onion ring
CEFoodOnionSlice.description: A more tolerable and easy to eat onion ring.

CEFoodAgaric.name: fly agaric
CEFoodAgaric.description: A bright red mushroom with white spots. Very pretty, and very poisonous.

CEFoodLumishroom.name: lumishroom
CEFoodLumishroom.description: A glowing cave mushroom. It ferments right in the cap, so eating a few goes straight to your head.

CEBloodpack.name: blood pack
CEBloodpack.description: Contains magical blood that is definitely not from space.

CEGauze.name: gauze
CEGauze.description: Dense cloth gauze, to prevent valuable blood from leaking out of the body.

CEPlastiseal.name: plastiseal
CEPlastiseal.description: A bandage net woven from afar powerful enough to remove poison and cure burn wounds.

CESmokingPipe.name: pipe
CESmokingPipe.description: A comfortable and practical smoking pipe, the latest fashion in the Empire.

CESpiceJarCinnamon.name: cinnamon jar
CESpiceJarCinnamon.description: A small glass jar for ground cinnamon.

CESpiceJarSpicyPepper.name: spicy pepper jar
CESpiceJarSpicyPepper.description: A small glass jar for ground hot pepper.

CEBell.name: bell
CEBell.description: A regular bell with a handle to attract attention.

CECandle.name: candle
CECandle.description: A thin wick threaded through fat.

CECandelabra.name: candelabra
CECandelabra.description: Several candles, beautifully placed on a metal support.

CEFloorTileItemBase.name: carpet
CEFloorTileItemBase.description: Rolled up carpet for easy transport.

CEFloorCarpetItemTasselScarletGold1.name: scarlet tasseled carpet with gold accents

CEHalloweenPumpkin.name: scary pumpkin
CEHalloweenPumpkin.description: It was a normal pumpkin one day... Now it's a scary pumpkin!

CEPlushieHuman.name: human plushie
CEPlushieHuman.description: The most basic one doesn't mean the worst one!

CEPlushieDwarf.name: dwarf plushie
CEPlushieDwarf.description: A very short, but sturdy lad... A good one to drink with, or from. Rock and stone!

CEPlushieElf.name: elf plushie
CEPlushieElf.description: It is unclear, if that thing is a man or a woman... But it can hold a bit of mana!

CEPlushieTiefling.name: tiefling plushie
CEPlushieTiefling.description: Be careful, don't stab your finger on the horn! So hot...

CEPlushieCarcat.name: carcat plushie
CEPlushieCarcat.description: Look at this adorable snout! Likes to be petted, sharpen its claws, and butcher dead bodies...

CEPlushieAgaric.name: myconide plushie
CEPlushieAgaric.description: The mushrooms are alive! I swear!

CEPlushieLumi.name: lumishroom plushie
CEPlushieLumi.description: A glowing plushie mushroom! With mouth!

CEPlushieFlem.name: flem plushie
CEPlushieFlem.description: There are no fish that walk on two legs. this is a myth.

CEPlushieGoldenHuman.name: golden human figurine
CEPlushieGoldenHuman.description: A small golden statue of a naked man. Ugly, but expensive.

CEPlushieGoldenDwarf.name: golden dwarf figurine
CEPlushieGoldenDwarf.description: I'm almost certain that the dwarves make these golden dwarves themselves, just for themselves. What an outrageous ego!

CEPlushieGoldenGoblin.name: golden goblin figurine
CEPlushieGoldenGoblin.description: Goblins really love golden goblin figurines! Although, they probably just love anything made of gold.

CEPlushieGoldenTiefling.name: golden tiefling figurine
CEPlushieGoldenTiefling.description: These sharp horns are made of metal! You heard that right. This golden figurine could easily be used as a weapon.

CEPlushieGoldenCarcat.name: golden carcat figurine
CEPlushieGoldenCarcat.description: This is a very old figurine of an old carcat. Some kind of very important guy. “Tyau” is scratched into the side.

CEPlushieGoldenFlem.name: golden flem figurine
CEPlushieGoldenFlem.description: Every gold flem is personalized. Each one is worth a fortune. Each one is utterly useless.

CEPlushieGoldenAgaric.name: golden myconid figurine
CEPlushieGoldenAgaric.description: The golden mushroom! A symbol of prosperity and health.

CEWallpaperItemBase.name: wallpaper roll
CEWallpaperItemBase.description: A roll of wallpaper. Glue it to a wall from whichever side you're standing on.

CEd20Dice.name: d20
CEd20Dice.description: What are the odds of me drinking wine and choking and dropping the candle on the dwarf's head?

CEd6Dice.name: d6
CEd6Dice.description: A bone cube for board games.

CEAsh1.name: ash
CEAsh1.description: It used to be something that could be interesting and useful, now it's not.

CEBone1.name: bone
CEBone1.description: A yellowed bone that once belonged to a living creature.

CEMediumBrassPipe1.name: medium brass pipe
CEMediumBrassPipe1.description: A  pipe for transferring mana energy. The brass casing insulates accidental spills, but if damaged, the flow can harm surrounding entities.

CEBigBrassPipe1.name: big brass pipe
CEBigBrassPipe1.description: A large pipe for transferring mana energy. The brass casing insulates accidental spills, but if damaged, the flow can harm surrounding entities.

CEPipeValve1.name: pipe valve
CEPipeValve1.description: When attached to a mana pipe, it allows you to easily control the flow of energy.

CECoinSilver1.name: silver coin
CECoinSilver1.description: A valuable coin made from a precisely calibrated silver alloy... and something else. Equal in value to ten coppers.

CECoinGold1.name: gold coin
CECoinGold1.description: A gold, big, beautiful coin. Valuable enough to be stolen by bandits. Equal in value to ten silver coins.

CECoinPlatinum1.name: platinum coin
CECoinPlatinum1.description: A platinum coin? It's so rare. Ten gold pieces is the price of one.

CEDiamondOre1.name: diamond ore
CEDiamondOre1.description: A chunk of rock with rough diamonds embedded in it. Can be smelted down to extract clean diamonds.

CEDiamond1.name: diamond
CEDiamond1.description: A clean, sparkling diamond. Incredibly hard and highly valued.

CEWoodenLadderItem.name: wooden ladder
CEWoodenLadderItem.description: A folded wooden ladder. Use it on a wall to mount it, or on an open edge next to you to hang it down to the level below.

CEBaseMachineCore.name: machine core
CEBaseMachineCore.description: A modular control core containing the circuitry and logic needed to assemble and operate advanced machines.

CEMachineCoreGridProjector.name: island power grid projector machine core

CEMachinePartEnergyLine1.name: energyline
CEMachinePartEnergyLine1.description: Reinforced energy cells connected in a line. A mechanical component often used to create large machines.

CEMachinePartCoalDiffuser1.name: coal diffuser
CEMachinePartCoalDiffuser1.description: Glass-carbon energy dissipator. Used as a material for mechanical engineering.

CEMachinePartDimensionalMatrix1.name: dimensional matrix
CEMachinePartDimensionalMatrix1.description: Fragments of demiplane cores filled with spatial distortions are used as ingredients to create more complex machines.

CENail1.name: nails
CENail1.description: A basic carpenter's tool that allows you to do unimaginable things with wood.

CEDirtBlock1.name: dirt block
CEDirtBlock1.description: A block of excellent black soil.

CESeedAppleTree.name: apple tree saplings
CESeedAppleTree.description: Apple tree saplings. Plant them to grow apple trees.

CEScrapIron1.name: iron scrap
CEScrapIron1.description: Crooked pieces of iron. Only to be melted down.

CEScrapBrass1.name: brass scrap
CEScrapBrass1.description: Crooked pieces of brass. The secret of producing this material has been lost. Only ancient ruins remain as a source of this valuable metal.

CESeedWheat.name: wheat seeds
CESeedWheat.description: Small wheat seeds. What will you do with them? Grind them into flour, or plant them again?

CESeedPumpkin.name: pumpkin seeds
CESeedPumpkin.description: Pumpkin seeds. Some pumpkin seems to have been gutted and butchered.

CESeedCucumber.name: cucumber seeds
CESeedCucumber.description: Are cucumber seeds. You know what to do with them.

CESeedTomato.name: tomato seeds
CESeedTomato.description: It looks like powder! They're so small, these seeds.

CESeedPepper.name: pepper seeds
CESeedPepper.description: Pepper seeds, with a peppercorn inside.

CESeedCotton.name: cotton seeds
CESeedCotton.description: Cotton seeds. It's time to grow some pants!

CEEnergyCrystalCell.name: energy crystal cell
CEEnergyCrystalCell.description: An energy crystal encased in a secure brass cell. It protects the crystal from accidental destruction and energy spillage into the air.

CEFloorTileBase.description: Makes the floor more pleasant for your feet. And your eyes.

CEFloorTileGrassBagBase.description: A bag of grass seed. A pinch of natural magic and the dirt is covered with a beautiful lawn in the blink of an eye!

CEIronBar1.name: iron bar
CEIronBar1.description: A heavy piece of refined iron

CEBrassBar1.name: brass bar
CEBrassBar1.description: The secret of how this metal is made has been lost over time, but that only makes it more valuable: it's the only metal that can isolate arcane energy, and without it, most modern tech wouldn't be possible.

CEGoldOre1.name: gold ore
CEGoldOre1.description: A chunk of ore veined with gold. Can be smelted down into gold bars.

CEGoldBar1.name: gold bar
CEGoldBar1.description: A heavy, gleaming bar of refined gold

CEIronOre1.name: iron ore
CEIronOre1.description: A chunk of iron-rich ore. Can be smelted down into usable iron bars.

CECoal1.name: coal
CECoal1.description: A chunk of coal. Can be used as fuel or in crafting.

CEBrassRod1.name: brass rod
CEBrassRod1.description: A solid rod of brass. Useful for crafting.

CEIronRod1.name: iron rod
CEIronRod1.description: A solid rod of iron. Useful for crafting.

CEBrassSheet1.name: brass sheet
CEBrassSheet1.description: Brass bars, hammered thin into sheets. Useful for crafting.

CEIronSheet1.name: iron sheet
CEIronSheet1.description: Iron bars, hammered thin into sheets. Useful for crafting.

CEGlassSheet1.name: glass sheet
CEGlassSheet1.description: Treated quartz glass, transmits light well, and is nice to look at!

CEMurkShield.name: murk shield
CEMurkShield.description: A small sphere that protects against darkness and lasts until sunset.

CEDropper.name: dropper
CEDropper.description: Small dropper for managing very small values of liquids

CESyringe.name: syringe
CESyringe.description: Used to draw blood samples from mobs, or to inject them with reagents.

CEVialTiny.name: tiny vial
CEVialTiny.description: A fragile glass vial to hold a tiny amount of liquid.

CEVialTinyReinforced.name: reinforced tiny vial
CEVialTinyReinforced.description: A reinforced glass vial to hold a tiny amount of liquid.

CEVialSmall.name: small vial
CEVialSmall.description: A fragile glass vial to hold a small amount of liquid.

CEVialSmallReinforced.name: reinforced small vial
CEVialSmallReinforced.description: A reinforced glass vial to hold a small amount of liquid.

CEVialMedium.name: medium vial
CEVialMedium.description: A fragile glass vial to hold a medium amount of liquid.

CEVialMediumReinforced.name: reinforced medium vial
CEVialMediumReinforced.description: A reinforced glass vial to hold a medium amount of liquid.

CEVialStar.name: star vial
CEVialStar.description: A fragile glass vial in the shape of a star, an unusual but symbolic shape.

CEVialStarReinforced.name: reinforced star vial
CEVialStarReinforced.description: A reinforced glass star-shaped vial to hold a small amount of liquid.

CEVialSkull.name: skull vial
CEVialSkull.description: A fragile skull-shaped vial in which to conveniently store poisonous liquids.

CEVialSkullReinforced.name: reinforced skull vial
CEVialSkullReinforced.description: A skull-shaped reinforced glass vial to hold a small amount of liquid, now the poison is sure not to accidentally spill onto your skin.

CEGroundTobacco.name: ground tobacco
CEGroundTobacco.description: Grinded and dried tabac leaves, some like it is a cure.

CEGroundSage.name: ground sage
CEGroundSage.description: Ground and dried sage root as it turns out is an excellent substitute for tobacco.

CELightShard1.name: first lightheart shard
CELightShard1.description: The first of the four shards needed to restore the Lucson Sphere.

CELightShard2.name: second lightheart shard
CELightShard2.description: The second of the four shards needed to restore the Lucson Sphere.

CELightShard3.name: third lightheart shard
CELightShard3.description: The third of the four shards needed to restore the Lucson Sphere.

CELightShard4.name: fourth lightheart shard
CELightShard4.description: The fourth of the four shards needed to restore the Lucson Sphere.

CERestorationRitualBook.name: restoration of the sphere
CERestorationRitualBook.description: Teaches the Restoration Ritual of the Lucson Sphere.

CEBaseKeyRing.name: key ring
CEBaseKeyRing.description: Allows you to comfortably store a large number of keys in one place.

CEWallet.name: wallet
CEWallet.description: A small wallet, handy for storing coins.

CEHandTeleporterAdmin.name: divine teleporter
CEHandTeleporterAdmin.description: Tears the fabric of the world. First use opens a rift, second use links it to a rift at your location, third closes both.

CEHandTeleporterAdminRift.name: rift
CEHandTeleporterAdminRift.description: A tear in the world leading somewhere else.

CESafeFallingAmulet.name: Emergency Levitation Amulet
CESafeFallingAmulet.description: An essential piece of everyday equipment for residents of the flying islands, protecting them from accidental falls from the island. Put it on your belt, and if you accidentally fall from the island, you will have a chance to save yourself.

CEVoiceDistortionAmulet.name: voice distortion amulet
CEVoiceDistortionAmulet.description: A shadowy trinket from the Murk. Worn on the belt, it distorts the wearer's voice beyond recognition.

CECrowbar.name: crowbar
CECrowbar.description: A sturdy iron crowbar, useful for prying things open.

CEHandLabeler.name: hand labeler
CEHandLabeler.description: A hand labeler, used to label items and objects.

CEThirdArm.name: manipulator arm
CEThirdArm.description: The most important tool for an engineering mana technician. A modular, battery-powered robotic arm capable of performing a variety of functions, depending on the module attached to it.

CEThirdArmModuleLight.name: manipulator light module
CEThirdArmModuleLight.description: Module for the manipulator arm. Provides a powerful light source.

CEThirdArmModuleManipulation.name: manipulator tool module
CEThirdArmModuleManipulation.description: Module for the manipulator arm. It allows you to build and take apart complex structures.

CEActionThirdArmManipulation.name: matter manipulation
CEActionThirdArmManipulation.description: Allows you to build and take apart complex structures.

CEThirdArmModuleMining.name: manipulator mining module
CEThirdArmModuleMining.description: Module for the manipulator arm. Equips the arm with a mining laser.

CEActionThirdArmMiningLaser.name: mining laser
CEActionThirdArmMiningLaser.description: Fire a series of precise laser beams capable of destroying structures.

CEInstrumentFlute.name: flute
CEInstrumentFlute.description: A compact musical wind instrument, popular in villages as well as with large musical troupes.

CEInstrumentLyra.name: lyra
CEInstrumentLyra.description: A common stringed instrument throughout Sylate, popular with various bards and musical troupes.

CEInstrumentGuitarSkeleton.name: skelute
CEInstrumentGuitarSkeleton.description: A true weapon for brutal rock skeletons. What does "rock" mean?

CERope.name: rope
CERope.description: Multifunctional rope. You can tie something with it. Or someone.

CESack.name: cloth sack
CESack.description: For convenient storage and transport of your belongings. Or to blind your enemies.

CEScissors.name: scissors
CEScissors.description: A tool for shredding wool, hair, clothing, and, if not handled carefully, even fingers.

CEScrewdriver.name: screwdriver
CEScrewdriver.description: Industrial grade torque in a small screwdriving package.

CEFork.name: fork
CEFork.description: Thousands of years of progress, and there it is, the fork.

CESpoon.name: spoon
CESpoon.description: It is considered the first tool for eating, not counting the hands.

CEBarSpoon.name: bar spoon
CEBarSpoon.description: A long twisted spoon for stirring cocktails.

CERag.name: damp rag
CERag.description: For cleaning up messes, you suppose.

CEFryingPan.name: frying pan
CEFryingPan.description: You can always watch three things: how fire burns, how water flows, and how delicious meat is cooked.

CEBowlBase.description: This is your bowl for a delicious soups!

CEPlateBase.description: This is your plate for a delicious meal!

CEBaseLockpick.name: iron lockpick
CEBaseLockpick.description: A thief's tool that, with proper skill, allows you to pick any lock.

CEKeyFile.name: key file
CEKeyFile.description: A file, ideal for sharpening keys, and reshaping them.

CEBaseLock.name: lock
CEBaseLock.description: A small device customized only for a specific key shape. Attach it to doors or chests that have no lock and feel the spirit of security.

CEBaseKey.name: key
CEBaseKey.description: A small, intricate piece of metal that opens some locks. Don't give it to anyone!

CEWeaponGunPeacekeeperGolden.name: golden Peacemaker
CEWeaponGunPeacekeeperGolden.description: A low-charge energy rifle that fires a powerful repulsive beam of concentrated mana. This is a special item, made as a one-off piece to order for the sheriff. It has a slightly higher ammunition capacity.

CEWeaponClubWooden.name: heavy club
CEWeaponClubWooden.description: A heavy wooden club. Blunt, brutal, and effective.

CEWeaponDaggerIron.name: iron dagger
CEWeaponDaggerIron.description: A standard dagger made of iron.

CEWeaponDaggerHatchet.name: hatchet
CEWeaponDaggerHatchet.description: A small hatchet, commonly used as a kitchen utensil for preparing food.

CEWeaponDaggerSickle.name: sickle
CEWeaponDaggerSickle.description: A curved blade used for harvesting crops, but can be deadly in skilled hands.

CEWeaponHammerIron.name: iron hammer
CEWeaponHammerIron.description: A standard hammer made of iron.

CEWeaponMaceTwoHandedSheriff.name: sheriff's mace
CEWeaponMaceTwoHandedSheriff.description: A mana-powered heavy mace used by the sheriff. When activated, it delivers a powerful blow that knocks back targets and drains their stamina.

CEActionSheriffMaceCharge.name: activate energy core
CEActionSheriffMaceCharge.description: Toggles the sheriff's mace's energy core, swapping its attack mode.

CEWeaponMop.name: mop
CEWeaponMop.description: A simple mop for cleaning up spills and messes.

CEWeaponPickaxeIron.name: iron pickaxe
CEWeaponPickaxeIron.description: A sturdy iron pickaxe, perfect for mining and not for combat.

CEWeaponShovelIron.name: iron shovel
CEWeaponShovelIron.description: A sturdy iron shovel, perfect for digging and not for combat.

CEWeaponSkimitarIron.name: iron skimitar
CEWeaponSkimitarIron.description: A curved iron blade, favored for its fast, sweeping strikes.

CEWeaponSpearIron.name: iron spear
CEWeaponSpearIron.description: A long iron-tipped spear. Excellent reach keeps enemies at bay.

CEWeaponStaffWooden.name: wooden staff
CEWeaponStaffWooden.description: A long wooden stick with an iron tip.

CEWeaponSwordIron.name: iron sword
CEWeaponSwordIron.description: A finely crafted sword favored by imperial officers. Its blade gleams with authority and tradition.

CEWeaponTwoHandedSwordIron.name: iron two-handed sword
CEWeaponTwoHandedSwordIron.description: A large and heavy two-handed sword. Heavy means reliable.

CEWeaponWarAxeIron.name: iron war axe
CEWeaponWarAxeIron.description: A large and heavy iron war axe. Heavy means reliable.

CEWeaponBowCombat.name: combat bow
CEWeaponBowCombat.description: A standard ranged weapon, and even without magic.

CEWeaponLightCrossbow.name: light crossbow
CEWeaponLightCrossbow.description: A small, compact crossbow that is comfortable to hold with one hand. Not too accurate on the reverse side.

CEArrowIron.name: arrow
CEArrowIron.description: A sharp arrow made of wood and metal.

CECrossboltIron.name: crossbow bolt
CECrossboltIron.description: Rod with a pointed spike in iron. No plumage, they're not bows.

CEBola.name: bola
CEBola.description: A tactical bola made of steel anchors linked by a strong rope. Reliable and reusable.

CEMurkLucsonSphere.name: Lucson Sphere
CEMurkLucsonSphere.description: Your last hope for survival. A barrier against the murk, a ray of light in the realm of darkness.

CEBaseFenceBig.name: big fence
CEBaseFenceBig.description: You definitely need a towel to get to the other side

CEBaseFenceGateBig.name: fence big gate
CEBaseFenceGateBig.description: Big man-sized gates. What's your next move?

CEBaseFence.name: fence
CEBaseFence.description: A low fence restricting movement in a purely nominal way.

CEBaseFenceWindow.name: fence window
CEBaseFenceWindow.description: You can slip an object in here, but you sure as hell can't fit through.

CEBaseFenceGate.name: fence gate
CEBaseFenceGate.description: You have two paths. You can open the door like a normal person, or you can climb over the door like a funny person.

CEBasePole.name: pole
CEBasePole.description: A simple wooden pole. Perfect for reinforcing fence sections and creating corner joints.

CEZLevelStairsBase.name: stairs
CEZLevelStairsBase.description: Be careful, the higher you ascend, the more painful the fall.

CEZLevelStairsFrameBase.name: stairs frame
CEZLevelStairsFrameBase.description: An unfinished wooden support frame. It needs to be covered before it's safe to climb.

CEZLevelStairsRoofBase.name: roof tile
CEZLevelStairsRoofBase.description: Roof tiles, for covering building roofs.

CEBaseThinWindow.name: thin window
CEBaseThinWindow.description: A narrow window that provides visibility while maintaining structure.

CEBaseThinWindowDoor.name: thin window door
CEBaseThinWindowDoor.description: Thin window doors. It has a latch; it can be unlocked and locked from only one side.

CEBaseThinWindowFrame.name: thin window frame
CEBaseThinWindowFrame.description: An unfinished window frame, waiting for glass panels.

CEBaseThinWindowDoorFrame.name: thin window hopper frame
CEBaseThinWindowDoorFrame.description: An unfinished hopper window frame, waiting for glass panels.

CEBaseWall.name: wall
CEBaseWall.description: Sturdy enough to cover you from threats or cold winds.

CEBaseWallFrame.description: This wall is now in an indeterminate state between existence and non-existence.

CEWallInvinsible.name: invinsible barrier
CEWallInvinsible.description: invinsible and indestructible wall for admemes.

CEWallStone.name: rock
CEWallStone.description: A solid stone natural wall. It has a cave-like coldness to it.

CEWallStoneIndestructable.name: dense rock
CEWallStoneIndestructable.description: An extremely durable stone. Your tools don't seem to be enough to break through it.

CEWallDirt.name: earth wall
CEWallDirt.description: A tall pile of dirt. Can a house be built from it?

CEWallLeafAutumn.name: autumn leaf wall
CEWallLeafAutumn.description: Dense, marginal bushes turned orange with the season. You can climb through them, but watch out for thorny branches!

CEWallSnow.name: snow wall
CEWallSnow.description: A tall pile of snow. Can a house be built from it?

CEWallIronCore.name: iron ore core
CEWallIronCore.description: An extremely hard and iron-rich ore core. You can certainly break it with a pickaxe, but it's better to use some kind of automatic drill...

CEWallCoalCore.name: coal ore core
CEWallCoalCore.description: An extremely hard and coal-rich ore core. You can certainly break it with a pickaxe, but it's better to use some kind of automatic drill...

CEWallCrystalCore.name: energy crystal core
CEWallCrystalCore.description: A core made of concentrated arcane energy crystals. It's extremely dangerous and can only be mined with specialized equipment.

CEWallDiamondCore.name: diamond ore core
CEWallDiamondCore.description: An incredibly hard core studded with diamonds. Pickaxes and ordinary drills just bounce off it - only an advanced drill or a manipulator's mining laser can break it.

CEWallGoldCore.name: gold ore core
CEWallGoldCore.description: An extremely hard and gold-rich ore core. You can certainly break it with a pickaxe, but it's better to use some kind of automatic drill...

CEBaseWindowFrame.description: Provides a nice breeze. The gap looks big enough to climb through.

CEBaseWindowFrameBroken.description: Broken window. You can get in, but the sharp splinters will tear your skin.

CEBaseBoneRemains.name: bone remains
CEBaseBoneRemains.description: The remains of bones have grown into the ground.

CEBoneSpine.name: bone spine
CEBoneSpine.description: The large bony torso of an unknown creature, as if it had been torn to pieces.

CEBoneDragon.name: bone dragon
CEBoneDragon.description: The large skeleton of a dragon, the possibility of encountering such a creature is both fascinating and terrifying.

CEWallmountPaintingCandle.name: candle painting
CEWallmountPaintingCandle.description: A nicely drawn candle in a frame.

CEWallmountPaintingWoman.name: painting of a woman
CEWallmountPaintingWoman.description: The painting depicts a woman with a mysterious smile.

CEWallmountPaintingSaint.name: painting of a saint
CEWallmountPaintingSaint.description: A drawing of a nun with a halo over her head. This is how you can feel the holiness of the picture.

CEStatueAngel.name: angel statue
CEStatueAngel.description: A divine statue of a praying angel.

CEStatueStoneHeadHigh.name: stone head
CEStatueStoneHeadHigh.description: Strange stone heads, they seem to be watching.

CEStatueWizard.name: statue wizard
CEStatueWizard.description: A statue of a magician holding magic.

CEBaseTombstone.name: tombstone
CEBaseTombstone.description: A piece of stone placed in memory of the dead.

CEArmchairMetallicBase.name: metal armchair
CEArmchairMetallicBase.description: A metal-framed armchair. Somebody thought comfort and cold iron could coexist.

CECashConverter.name: cash converter
CECashConverter.description: A simple magical device connected by small portals to the empire's central bank. It allows you to convert coins between denominations, and doesn't even charge interest! That's generous.

CEMannequinBase.description: A handy stand for clothing or armor.

CEOrderBoard.name: orders board
CEOrderBoard.description: Is there a job for a witcher?

CEPot.name: clay pot
CEPot.description: A fragile clay pot. Who knows what is hidden inside?

CEPottedPlantBase.name: potted plant
CEPottedPlantBase.description: A domesticated plant in a clay pot, more plants.

CEWoodenSpikes.name: wooden spikes
CEWoodenSpikes.description: Sharp wooden stakes stuck into the ground. You definitely don't want to fall on them!

CEBaseTorch.description: A good, reliable light source. Too bad it doesn't last.

CEFloorMurkTorchAlwaysPowered.name: murk torch
CEFloorMurkTorchAlwaysPowered.description: The violet lights of the wandering shadow-merchants, who have regained their minds.

CEGoldChest.name: golden chest
CEGoldChest.description: An ornate chest gilded in gold.

CETableWooden.name: wooden table
CETableWooden.description: A simple table made of boards.

CETableWoodenMetallic.name: wooden reinforced table
CETableWoodenMetallic.description: A simple table made of boards, with metal border reinforcements.

CETableWoodenMetallicCounter.name: wooden reinforced counter
CETableWoodenMetallicCounter.description: A simple counter made of boards, with metal border reinforcements.

CETableWoodenRound.name: round wooden table
CETableWoodenRound.description: A simple table made of boards.

CEWallmountBarShelf.name: bar shelf
CEWallmountBarShelf.description: Wall shelves to store your wine collection

CEWallmountKeyRack.name: key rack
CEWallmountKeyRack.description: Wooden wall board with slots for keys.

CEWoodenLadder.name: wooden ladder
CEWoodenLadder.description: A wooden ladder nailed to the wall. Walk into the wall to climb, walk slowly to hold on.

CEGridStabilityCore.name: flying island core
CEGridStabilityCore.description: The energy of this air crystal is capable of keeping a huge island suspended in the air. Cherish it as the apple of your eye: the lives of all its inhabitants depend on its integrity.

CEPressTargetAnvil.name: industrial anvil
CEPressTargetAnvil.description: A solid anvil for an industrial press. It is used to flatten objects into flatter shapes.

CEShuttleWingBase.name: airship wing
CEShuttleWingBase.description: Giant webbed wings, capable, along with magic, of holding the heaviest objects in the air.

CEWallLightBase.name: wall lamp
CEWallLightBase.description: A light fixture. Draws power and produces light.

CEDrillAdvanced.name: advanced stationary drill
CEDrillAdvanced.description: An industrial drill rebuilt with reinforced components, hitting twice as hard as the standard model.

CEPipeBrassBigValve.name: big valve
CEPipeBrassBigValve.description: A valve installed on a brass pipe, allowing for the regulation of arcane energy flow through the pipe.

CEPipeBrassBigBroken.description: Damaged brass pipe. The arcane energy flowing through them will flow here and may pose a serious danger to creatures susceptible to magic.

CEPipeBrassMediumBase.description: Insulated brass pipe with iron supports. A standardized method of transmitting arcane energy over long distances. However, any holes or cracks can lead to energy leakage and harm to surrounding creatures susceptible to magic.

CEPipeBrassMediumValve.name: medium valve
CEPipeBrassMediumValve.description: A valve installed on a brass pipe, allowing for the regulation of arcane energy flow through the pipe.

CEPipeBrassMediumBroken.description: Damaged brass pipe. The arcane energy flowing through them will flow here and may pose a serious danger to creatures susceptible to magic.

CECrystalGrowths.name: crystalline growths
CECrystalGrowths.description: Crystallized magical energy that appears in places with high concentrations of mana. Can be used as a one-time source of energy.

CEFloorCrystal.name: crystal growths
CEFloorCrystal.description: Crystallized magical energy that appears in places with high concentrations of mana. Can be used as a one-time source of energy.

CEBaseRock.name: rock
CEBaseRock.description: A piece of rock. Hard, heavy, useless.

CESnowdrift.name: snowdrift
CESnowdrift.description: A big, cold pile of snow.

CEPlantDeadBase.name: dead plant
CEPlantDeadBase.description: A withered, lifeless husk. Clear it away before planting here again.

CEBaseTree.name: tree
CEBaseTree.description: Decades of life and growth, saturating the surrounding nature with fresh air.

CERitualPedestal.name: ritual pedestal
CERitualPedestal.description: A pedestal for a lightheart shard. When every shard lies near the Lucson Sphere, the Restoration Ritual can begin.

CEShadowRift.name: shadow rift
CEShadowRift.description: A tear in the world. Shadow traders come out of it at nightfall and slip back in at dawn.

CEActionEnterShadowRift.name: enter the rift
CEActionEnterShadowRift.description: Steps back into the shadow rift.

CETradeCarpetBase.name: murk trade carpet
CETradeCarpetBase.description: Traders post their items for sale here

CETradePostamentBase.name: murk trade postament
CETradePostamentBase.description: Traders showcase their special goods here

CEObjectiveRecruiterRecruit.name: Recruit people
CEObjectiveRecruiterRecruit.description: Find loyal people, willing to abandon their personal goals to become part of the Brotherhood.

CEObjectiveThiefCashOut.name: Spend 10 gold in the shadow shop
CEObjectiveThiefCashOut.description: Spend 10 gold coins on purchases in the shadow shop.

CEObjectiveBrotherhoodSurvive.name: Keep every Brotherhood member alive
CEObjectiveBrotherhoodSurvive.description: Every member of the Brotherhood must survive.

CEObjectiveBrotherhoodPatronage.name: Help someone complete all their objectives
CEObjectiveBrotherhoodPatronage.description: This person once helped the Brotherhood. Repay the favor - they must complete all of their objectives.

CEObjectiveBrotherhoodDebt.name: Put someone in critical condition 3 times without killing them
CEObjectiveBrotherhoodDebt.description: This person once crossed the Brotherhood. Make their life unbearable - they must end up in critical condition 3 times, yet survive to learn their lesson.

CEObjectiveBountyHunterEliminate.name: Kill every Brotherhood member
CEObjectiveBountyHunterEliminate.description: Every member of the Brotherhood must be dead.

CEObjectiveDarkVesselSwap.name: Move into a new body
CEObjectiveDarkVesselSwap.description: Your current body, your vessel, is almost completely worn out. You need a new body to go on existing.

CEObjectiveLoverAssist.name: Help your beloved
CEObjectiveLoverAssist.description: Do whatever it takes to help the person you secretly love complete every one of their personal objectives.

CEObjectiveLoverSurvive.name: Keep your beloved alive
CEObjectiveLoverSurvive.description: The person you secretly love must survive.

CEObjectivePriestSurvive.name: Survive
CEObjectivePriestSurvive.description: There are creatures in this city who crave my death.

CEObjectivePriestProtect.name: Keep someone alive
CEObjectivePriestProtect.description: You swore an oath to protect the innocent from death, and you will keep it.

CEObjectiveSheriffDestroyDarkness.name: Kill every nightmare
CEObjectiveSheriffDestroyDarkness.description: Every nightmare hiding in the city must be dead.

CEObjectiveCityRestoreLucsonSphere.name: Restore the Lucson Sphere
CEObjectiveCityRestoreLucsonSphere.description: Buy the lightheart shards and the restoration book from the Shadow Caravan, then perform the Restoration Ritual at the Lucson Sphere before the murk consumes the city.

CEObjectiveNightmareKillPriests.name: Kill every priest
CEObjectiveNightmareKillPriests.description: There are priests of light in this city whose very existence is repugnant to your nature. Find them out and kill them.

CEObjectiveNightmareSphereCollapse.name: Keep the Lucson Sphere from being restored
CEObjectiveNightmareSphereCollapse.description: The lucson sphere has cracked. Keep the city from restoring it until the murk consumes it.

CEActionDarkSideBanishment.name: Banishment to the dark side
CEActionDarkSideBanishment.description: With a touch, you cast a creature out of the material world for a minute. Only those who perceive magic can see it there.

CEActionToggleDarkSideWalk.name: Walk on the dark side
CEActionToggleDarkSideWalk.description: Step out of the material world, or return to it, at will.

CEStatusEffectDarkSide.name: on the dark side
CEStatusEffectDarkSide.description: You are outside the material world. Only those who perceive magic can see you.

CEActionImperialSalary200.name: Imperial salary
CEActionImperialSalary200.description: The Empire pays its servants 2 gold coins at every dawn. Collect the salary accumulated so far.

CEActionToggleMagicVision.name: Magical vision
CEActionToggleMagicVision.description: You focus on magical flows, perceiving the hidden world of magic.

CEStatusEffectMagicVision.name: magical vision
CEStatusEffectMagicVision.description: You perceive the hidden world of magic.

CEActionManaControl.name: Mana control
CEActionManaControl.description: Switch between restoring and spending your mana.

CEStatusEffectManaRegen.name: mana regeneration
CEStatusEffectManaRegen.description: Your mana is constantly being restored.

CEStatusEffectManaDrain.name: mana drain
CEStatusEffectManaDrain.description: Your mana is constantly being spent.

CEActionMilitaryTraining.name: Military training
CEActionMilitaryTraining.description: Rigorous drilling has taught your body to push past exhaustion and fear. Catch your second wind to instantly restore your stamina and shake off primal terror.

CEStatusEffectMurkwalker.name: Murk Immunity
CEStatusEffectMurkwalker.description: You can safely stand in the murk without dissolving into oblivion.

CEStatusEffectMurkResistance.name: Murk Resistance
CEStatusEffectMurkResistance.description: You dissolve in the murk 30% slower.

CEActionRestorationRitual.name: Restoration Ritual of the Lucson Sphere
CEActionRestorationRitual.description: Begin the ritual on the cracked Lucson Sphere once every lightheart shard lies on the ritual pedestals. The exposed core must survive until the ritual ends.

CEActionShopEmpireSheriff.name: Imperial supply
CEActionShopEmpireSheriff.description: Order equipment from the Empire's warehouses.

CEStatusEffectSoftLanding.name: Soft Landing
CEStatusEffectSoftLanding.description: Softens falls from a height, reducing damage and preventing you from being knocked down as long as the fall speed is not too high.

CEStatusEffectTimeSense.name: Sense of Time
CEStatusEffectTimeSense.description: You intuitively feel what time of day it is.

CEActionRecruit.name: Recruitment
CEActionRecruit.description: Invite someone nearby to join the Brotherhood. They can refuse.

CEActionSoulGaze.name: Soul gaze
CEActionSoulGaze.description: Look into someone's soul and see their true nature. They will feel it.

CEActionDarkVesselSwap.name: Change the vessel
CEActionDarkVesselSwap.description: Leave this old body, this old vessel, and move into a new one, taking over all its objectives and abilities. Only works on the corpse of a player who held a secret role.

CEStatusEffectMysticVitality.name: Mystic Vitality
CEStatusEffectMysticVitality.description: No matter how hard you are beaten, you are almost impossible to kill, and you keep coming back, regenerating any damage taken. You can still be killed, of course - by being thrown off the island, for example - but try not to talk about that.

CEActionLurkerFear.name: Primal Terror
CEActionLurkerFear.description: You plunge the target into primal terror, crippling their ability to fight back.

CEActionLurkerJump.name: Jump
CEActionLurkerJump.description: You perform a powerful leap that can raise you by one level.

CEActionLurkerShadowStep.name: Shadow Step
CEActionLurkerShadowStep.description: A step through a tear in reality to a nearby spot you can see.

CEActionSpellCureWounds.name: Cure wounds
CEActionSpellCureWounds.description: You restore health to the creature you touch.

CEActionSpellDivineShield.name: Divine shield
CEActionSpellDivineShield.description: You shield the creature you touch, halving all damage it takes for 30 seconds.

CEActionSpellResurrection.name: Resurrection
CEActionSpellResurrection.description: You return the soul of the dead creature you touch back into its body, fully healing its wounds. Fails if the soul has left the body for good.

CEActionSpellFeatherFall.name: Feather Fall
CEActionSpellFeatherFall.description: You call forth a gentle updraft that greatly weakens gravity for everyone in the area, letting them fall slowly and safely.

CEActionFrostBlade.name: Frost blade
CEActionFrostBlade.description: You create a powerful temporary weapon made of ice that deals high damage.

CEWeaponSwordFrostTemporary.name: frost blade
CEWeaponSwordFrostTemporary.description: A magical weapon woven from ice, which will soon melt away.

CEActionSpellManaGift.name: Mana gift
CEActionSpellManaGift.description: You restore mana to the selected target.

CEActionSpellManaSteal.name: Mana steal
CEActionSpellManaSteal.description: You steal mana from the target and add it to your own reserves.

CEActionSpellPlantGrowth.name: Plant Growth
CEActionSpellPlantGrowth.description: You channel vital essence into the area, feeding nearby plants energy and resources and nudging their growth forward, while also mending the wounds of any creatures caught in the bloom.

CEActionWerewolfTransform.name: True Form
CEActionWerewolfTransform.description: Give in to the beast and take your true, wolf form. Only works at night.

CEClothingCloakCapeBarbarian.name: barbarian cape
CEClothingCloakCapeBarbarian.description: A rugged cape favored by barbarians, often made from rough hides.

CEClothingCloakCapeFur.name: fur cape
CEClothingCloakCapeFur.description: A warm fur cape ideal for cold climates.

CEClothingCloakCapeFur2.name: fur cape variant
CEClothingCloakCapeFur2.description: A secondary fur cape style with a different fur pattern.

CEClothingCloakBlue.name: blue cloak
CEClothingCloakBlue.description: A simple blue cloak for everyday travel and protection.

CEClothingCloakCommandant.name: commandant's cloak
CEClothingCloakCommandant.description: A stately cloak worn by high-ranking officers and commandants.

CEClothingCloakSheriff.name: sheriff's cloak
CEClothingCloakSheriff.description: A prestigious cloak worn by the sheriff, denoting authority.

CEClothingCloakBrigadier.name: brigadier's cloak
CEClothingCloakBrigadier.description: A status item that only senior foremen responsible for the integrity of the island are allowed to wear. The fabric is stitched with thin brass threads, providing excellent insulation from magical radiation.

CEClothingCloakGuildmaster.name: guildmaster's cloak
CEClothingCloakGuildmaster.description: A ceremonial crimson cloak worn by the head of the adventurers' guild.

CEClothingCloakInsulatedMantle.name: insulated mantle
CEClothingCloakInsulatedMantle.description: An insulated mantle designed to retain heat in cold conditions.

CEClothingCloakVampireWhite.name: white vampire cloak
CEClothingCloakVampireWhite.description: An elegant white cloak favored by vampire nobility.

CEClothingCloakVampireBlue.name: blue vampire cloak
CEClothingCloakVampireBlue.description: A dark blue cloak with vampiric styling.

CEClothingCloakVampireRed.name: red vampire cloak
CEClothingCloakVampireRed.description: A crimson cloak favored by vampiric aristocracy.

CEClothingCloakCoatFur.name: fur coat
CEClothingCloakCoatFur.description: A luxurious fur coat made for warmth and style.

CEClothingCloakCoatFurBrown.name: brown fur coat
CEClothingCloakCoatFurBrown.description: A rugged brown fur coat for colder climates.

CEClothingCloakMantleAlchemist.name: alchemist's mantle
CEClothingCloakMantleAlchemist.description: A mantle worn by alchemists, often used to protect clothing from spills and reagents.

CEClothingCloakMantleThaumaturge.name: thaumaturge's mantle
CEClothingCloakMantleThaumaturge.description: A formal mantle worn by thaumaturges of the Academy, with an attachable ceremonial hood.

CEClothingCloakBlacksmithApron.name: blacksmith apron
CEClothingCloakBlacksmithApron.description: A heavy apron used by blacksmiths to protect against sparks and heat.

CEClothingCloakCheetahSkin.name: cheetah skin cloak
CEClothingCloakCheetahSkin.description: A wild cheetah skin cloak used for ceremonial dress or hunting.

CEClothingCloakHaori.name: haori
CEClothingCloakHaori.description: A traditional haori jacket used in formal and casual settings.

CEClothingCloakMaidApron.name: maid apron
CEClothingCloakMaidApron.description: A neatly kept apron typically worn by maids and domestic staff.

CEClothingCloakRaincoatAlchemist.name: alchemist's raincoat
CEClothingCloakRaincoatAlchemist.description: A protective raincoat used by alchemists to shield reagents from the weather.

CEClothingCloakRaincoatGreen.name: green raincoat
CEClothingCloakRaincoatGreen.description: A waterproof green raincoat for everyday use.

CEClothingCloakRaincoatSheriff.name: sheriff's raincoat
CEClothingCloakRaincoatSheriff.description: A reinforced raincoat issued to the sheriff for weather protection while on duty.

CEClothingCloakRaincoatWhite.name: white raincoat
CEClothingCloakRaincoatWhite.description: A crisp white raincoat commonly used by professionals requiring a clean appearance.

CEClothingMaskVampireVoiceBase.description: This mask reeks of blood. Effectively conceals the identity of the wearer.

CEClothingShirtSyurkoBlack.name: black syurko
CEClothingShirtSyurkoBlack.description: A traditional syurko cloak in black.

CEClothingShirtSyurkoBlue.name: blue syurko
CEClothingShirtSyurkoBlue.description: A blue syurko cloak with distinct cultural patterns.

CEClothingShirtSyurkoGreen.name: green syurko
CEClothingShirtSyurkoGreen.description: A green syurko cloak often used in ceremonial settings.

CEClothingShirtSyurkoSheriff.name: sheriff's syurko
CEClothingShirtSyurkoSheriff.description: A syurko styled for the sheriff's uniform.

CEClothingShirtSyurkoRed.name: red syurko
CEClothingShirtSyurkoRed.description: A bright red syurko favored by certain regions.

CEClothingShirtSyurkoWhite.name: white syurko
CEClothingShirtSyurkoWhite.description: A pristine white syurko, often used for ceremonies.

CEClothingShirtSyurkoYellow.name: yellow syurko
CEClothingShirtSyurkoYellow.description: A yellow syurko that stands out in parades and festivals.

CEMobWerewolf.name: werewolf
CEMobWerewolf.description: A terrifying and extremely dangerous creature of the night. By day, it hides under the guise of your friendly neighbor.

CEMobLurker.name: lurker
CEMobLurker.description: The spirit of hunger and night. The Hunter of Lost Solitaries

CEMobShadowEater.name: shadow eater
CEMobShadowEater.description: A being of darkness that feeds on the shadows of living creatures.

CEMobShadowTrader.name: shadow trader
CEMobShadowTrader.description: A silent shade that keeps the shop shelves stocked.

CEFoodCheeseWheel.name: cheese wheel
CEFoodCheeseWheel.description: A large wheel of soft, fragrant piece of cheese.

CEFoodCheesePart.name: cheese
CEFoodCheesePart.description: A triangle of soft, fragrant cheese.

CEFoodDoughLarge.name: large piece of dough
CEFoodDoughLarge.description: The perfect ingredient for any flour product. The only thing left to do is to shape it.

CEFoodMeatPig.name: raw pig meat
CEFoodMeatPig.description: I've eaten pork, I eat pork, and it looks like I'll be eating pork forever and ever.

CEFoodMeatBoar.name: raw boar meat
CEFoodMeatBoar.description: It's like pig meat, except more odorous.

CEFoodMeatMonster.name: raw monster meat
CEFoodMeatMonster.description: The colour is quite suspicious, not everyone would dare to try it out, perhaps give it to a goblin?

CEWheat.name: wheat bushel
CEWheat.description: You have the choice of either planting the grains again or grinding them into flour.

CECotton.name: cotton
CECotton.description: A plant raw fiber used to make cotton fabric.

CEFoodTomatoes.name: tomatoes
CEFoodTomatoes.description: A red, juicy tomato. You just want to throw it in someone's face!

CEFoodApple.name: apple
CEFoodApple.description: A fruit for lovers of a quick snack.

CEFoodGarlic.name: garlic
CEFoodGarlic.description: A bulb of garlic, full of flavor and pungency.

CEFoodCorn.name: ear of corn
CEFoodCorn.description: Needs some butter! And some cooking...

CEFoodCarrot.name: carrot
CEFoodCarrot.description: A bright orange carrot, crunchy and sweet.

CEFoodOnion.name: onion
CEFoodOnion.description: If you eat too much, you can cry tears of joy.

CEFoodSunflowerHead.name: sunflower head
CEFoodSunflowerHead.description: A cut flower from a cheerful, sun-loving plant. Inside are lots of delicious seeds.

CEOpenSign.name: flip sign "Open"
CEOpenSign.description: A small double-sided sign that can be turned over

CEClosedSign.name: flip sign "Closed"
CEClosedSign.description: A small double-sided sign that can be turned over

CEPlushieGoblin.name: goblin plushie
CEPlushieGoblin.description: A sneaky one, for sure... It seems like you can put a coin in it, but it's not clear if you can get it back!

CEPlushieSilva.name: silva plushie
CEPlushieSilva.description: A little cute bush! You can put some seeds in it, but sadly, they won't grow...

CEEnergyCrystalShard.name: energy crystal shard
CEEnergyCrystalShard.description: Crystallized magical energy that appears in places with high concentrations of mana. Can be used as a one-time source of energy.

CEWoodLog.name: wooden log
CEWoodLog.description: A piece of unprocessed wood. Good material for building, or starting a fire.

CELantern.name: lantern
CELantern.description: A device that converts energy from crystals into a source of directional light. Convenient for traveling.

CEManaTransferGlove.name: mana transfer glove
CEManaTransferGlove.description: A glove that allows transferring mana to and from mana-storing entities.

CETorch.name: torch
CETorch.description: At its core, a stick burning on one side. Used to light up the area.

CEWrench.name: wrench
CEWrench.description: A common tool for assembly and disassembly. Remember: lefty latchy, righty removey.

CESnowball.name: snowball
CESnowball.description: A small handful of snow, handy for throwing.

CEWeaponGunJustice.name: Justice Revolver
CEWeaponGunJustice.description: A fast and convenient sheriff's revolver that can be easily fired with two hands.

CEWeaponGunPeacekeeper.name: Peacekeeper
CEWeaponGunPeacekeeper.description: A low-charge energy rifle that fires a powerful repulsive beam of concentrated mana.

CEIronDoor.name: iron door
CEIronDoor.description: Well, if there's a solid iron door, there must be something valuable behind it.

CEIronDoorWindowed.name: iron windowed door
CEIronDoorWindowed.description: a solid iron door with a small window. You can look through it, of course, but it's hard to put your hand through.

CEWoodenDoor.name: wooden door
CEWoodenDoor.description: Not the most solid construction, but it's better than nothing.

CEWoodenDoorWindowed.name: wooden windowed door
CEWoodenDoorWindowed.description: Not the most solid construction, but it's better than nothing.

CEWallLeaf.name: leaf wall
CEWallLeaf.description: Dense, marginal bushes. You can climb through them, but watch out for thorny branches!

CEWindowStone.name: stone window
CEWindowStone.description: A stone wall with a glass window in it.

CEWindowWooden.name: wooden window
CEWindowWooden.description: A wooden wall with a glass window in it.

CEWallmauntGarlandBase.name: crystals garland
CEWallmauntGarlandBase.description: Carefully crafted sparkling crystals tied on a string. For a festive attitude.

CEArmchairBase.name: armchair
CEArmchairBase.description: A plush armchair, perfect for sinking into after a long day.

CEBaseBarrel.name: wooden barrel
CEBaseBarrel.description: The simplest design for storing liquids.

CECraneBarrel.name: wooden crane barrel
CECraneBarrel.description: Large lying barrel with tap, for storing valuable liquids.

CECraneBarrelSmall.name: wooden small crane barrel
CECraneBarrelSmall.description: A small lying barrel with a tap to quickly pour liquid into mugs.

CEBedsideTableWooden.name: wooden bedside table
CEBedsideTableWooden.description: A small place to store everyday items

CEBenchWood.name: wood bench
CEBenchWood.description: A bench carved from wood, a comfortable part of the interior designed for sitting and relaxing.

CECabinetWooden.name: wooden cabinet
CECabinetWooden.description: Keep an eye on the skeletons in your closet.

CEChairWooden.name: wooden chair
CEChairWooden.description: Made of the most common planks. Simple and effective!

CEClockBig.name: grandfather clock
CEClockBig.description: A tall wooden clock with a swinging pendulum.

CEMannequinSnowman.name: snowman
CEMannequinSnowman.description: Someone had the idea to stack up big snowballs, and for some reason people call it a snow "man".

CETargetStake.name: target stake
CETargetStake.description: A wooden stand on which to fix a target for firing.

CETargetEffigy.name: target effigy
CETargetEffigy.description: The target is a scarecrow for practising close combat strikes.... or magic.

CEWoodenChest.name: wooden chest
CEWoodenChest.description: A simple wooden chest for easy storage of junk.

CEWorkbench.name: workbench
CEWorkbench.description: Table for the production of various basic tools.

CEEngineeringTable.name: engineering table
CEEngineeringTable.description: A place for creating various engineering machine parts.

CEHeater.name: heater
CEHeater.description: a mechanism that converts energy into a controlled burning flame

CEPress.name: industrial press
CEPress.description: Once powered up, the heavy press will be ready to rise and crush any objects beneath it. Use specialized press platforms to achieve the desired result.

CEBaseAutoCrafter.name: automatic workbench
CEBaseAutoCrafter.description: An automated crafting station that continuously produces the selected recipe.

CECharger.name: energy charger
CECharger.description: A mechanism that allows filling with mana anything, from tools to goblins.

CEDrill.name: stationary drill
CEDrill.description: A large industrial drill capable of destroying anything with a constant supply of energy. It was designed by imperial engineers to extract particularly hard ore deposits.

CEFunnel.name: funnel
CEFunnel.description: A device for placing items inside storage facilities or removing items from them. To extract items, attach a conveyor belt.

CEMapProjector.name: map projector
CEMapProjector.description: Projects a three-dimensional rotating model of the island

CEMurkShieldGenerator.name: murk shield generator
CEMurkShieldGenerator.description: Kindles the murk shield at every dawn, if it has power. Only one shield burns at a time, no matter how many generators there are.

CEPowerGridProjector.name: island power grid projector
CEPowerGridProjector.description: Projects a three-dimensional rotating model of the island with a detailed layout of all energy devices.

CERecycler.name: recycler
CERecycler.description: A large destructive machine used to extract energy from magical items by destroying them. It can also be used as a way to recycle items into basic materials.

CESolutionNormalizer.name: solution normalizer
CESolutionNormalizer.description: An alchemical device that destroys the reagent that is least present in a solution poured into it, gradually normalizing mixtures down to their dominant reagents. Requires power to operate.

CEAccumulatorVesselBase.name: accumulator vessel
CEAccumulatorVesselBase.description: A structure that collects magical energy and stores it for later use.

CEEnergyExtractor.name: energy extractor
CEEnergyExtractor.description: Splits crystals and other unstable items fed into its hopper, dumping the released energy straight into the city grid. Attach a funnel and a conveyor belt to keep it stocked.

CEGeneratorMagicCapacitor.name: air capacitor
CEGeneratorMagicCapacitor.description: Absorbs magical energy diffusing in the air, condenses it into a liquid form that can be transported through brass pipes.

CEPipeBrassBigBase.description: Insulated brass pipe with iron supports. A standardized method of transmitting arcane energy over long distances. However, any holes or cracks can lead to energy leakage and harm to surrounding creatures susceptible to magic.

CEPlantAgaric.name: fly agaric
CEPlantAgaric.description: A bright red mushroom with white spots. Better not to eat it.

CEPlantAppleTree.name: apple tree
CEPlantAppleTree.description: A sturdy tree that bears delicious apples.

CEPlantCabbage.name: cabbage
CEPlantCabbage.description: You see a cabbage in front of you. Perhaps you were born in one.

CEPlantCarrot.name: carrot
CEPlantCarrot.description: In this world, they have not yet learned to use carrots as noses for snowmen.

CEPlantChanterelle.name: chanterelle
CEPlantChanterelle.description: A type of wild mushroom with a distinctive yellow color and a slightly fruity aroma.

CEPlantCorn.name: corn
CEPlantCorn.description: There are rumors that lurkers can be found inside cornfields.

CEPlantCotton.name: cotton
CEPlantCotton.description: In a way, you're growing future clothes.

CEPlantCucumber.name: cucumber
CEPlantCucumber.description: Don't trust people who know how to turn into pickles.

CEPlantGarlic.name: garlic
CEPlantGarlic.description: Only humans figured out how to take a sharp, unpalatable root vegetable and use it as a seasoning wherever possible.

CEPlantLumishroom.name: lumishroom
CEPlantLumishroom.description: A cave mushroom with a softly glowing green cap. It smells of yeast and strong drink.

CEPlantOnion.name: onion
CEPlantOnion.description: He's so cute it brings tears to my eyes to cut him up.

CEPlantPepper.name: pepper
CEPlantPepper.description: Russian roulette. Are you hot, or are you sweet peppers?

CEPlantPotato.name: potato
CEPlantPotato.description: Some like to associate themselves with potatoes. People like that are not bad people.

CEPlantPumpkin.name: pumpkin
CEPlantPumpkin.description: Legends say there is a pumpkin king who stares into your soul through the crowns of trees.

CEPlantSunflower.name: sunflower
CEPlantSunflower.description: A tall, sun-loving plant that produces large, bright yellow flowers.

CEPlantTomatoes.name: tomatoes
CEPlantTomatoes.description: On the one hand, it's a delicious fruit. But why eat it when it's much more fun to use tomatoes as a throwing projectile?

CEPlantWheat.name: wheat
CEPlantWheat.description: Most popular crop. Unpretentious, it opens the way to an abundance of flour products.
